_: A組 #5+#6 location-aware encounter. A ChangeLocation Story-Manager quest that fires only when the player enters a location with a LocType keyword (locationFilter, OR'd) and not more often than cooldownHours (anti-spam, the EE_WITimeout pattern). The build appends GetKeywordDataForCurrentLocation conditions to the SM event conditions, creates a <quest>_LastFired GLOB, and attaches the reusable MFEncounterCooldown script (which Stop()s the quest if it re-fired within the window). Add stages/dialogue/aliases to make it actually DO something on fire. ⚠ locationFilter conditions are pure CTDA (offline-verifiable); the cooldown SCRIPT runtime behaviour needs a main-machine in-game check (see WAIT_USER). LocType FormIDs here are real vanilla (LocTypeBanditCamp 0x130F2, LocTypeDungeon 0x130DE) — verify with `gamedata find`.

storyEvent._: Fires only in a bandit camp OR a dungeon, at most once per 12 in-game hours.
